title: Global L-Shape Desk with 36"H Privacy Panel — 72"W x 72"D
body_html:
An L-shaped desk that arrives with privacy built in — a 36" panel rising straight off the worksurface to carve out a focused, screened workspace.

This Global L-shape desk pairs a generous 72"W x 72"D laminate footprint with a desk-mounted privacy panel that stands 36" above the surface, giving each user a clearly defined and visually separated work zone. The modular panel integrates directly with the desk, so open-plan teams gain focus without sacrificing the collaborative floor plan. Made in Canada and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty, it ships flat for on-site assembly.

Key features

  • L-shaped 72"W x 72"D laminate desk configuration for private offices and open-plan workstations
  • Desk-mounted privacy panel standing 36" above the worksurface for visual separation
  • Modular Divide-style panel system that integrates directly with the desk
  • Assembly required; configurable for the workspace footprint

Who it’s for

Private offices and open-plan workstations in municipal, education, and healthcare administrative environments that need a defined personal work zone with built-in visual privacy.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
